# Veycraft — GitHub Copilot

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [skills/REGISTRY.md](../skills/REGISTRY.md) first (or auto-discover wrappers in [`.agents/skills/`](../.agents/skills/)); only load a full skill body when its trigger matches the current phase of work (such as `skills/54-github-cli-remote-manager.md` for no-clone `gh` CLI operations, `skills/55-freelance-profile-and-service-publisher.md` for freelance service publishing, and `skills/56-freelance-offer-radar-and-batch-bidder.md` for freelance offer radar and approved batch bidding).

This is a **Markdown-first career operations repository with a zero-dependency Node.js CLI (`bin/cli.mjs`)**, native offline `veycraft` MCP tools (`veycraft_route`, `veycraft_get_skill`, `veycraft://manifest`, `veycraft://skill/<name>`), and optional Playwright/Notion MCP. Use `docs/chat-commands.md` for `/demo`, `/quick-tailor`, `/setup`, `/daily-run`, `/tailor-cv`, `/apply-url`, `/weekly-report`, `/github-audit`, `/github-remote`, `/freelance-service`, `/freelance-bid`, and `/linkedin-growth`. Connect optional Playwright MCP and Notion MCP from `mcp/mcp.template.json`. Never invent facts, bypass challenges, or submit without explicit job-specific human `APPROVE`.
